Name: Ahijah, Treasurer
Summary: Levite over the treasures of the house of God and the treasures of the dedicated things.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:20: Levite over the treasures of the house of God and the treasures of the dedicated things.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ahijah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
